learning_outcomes.text: To be able to classify non-destructive material testing methods.
To be able to distinguish material defects.
To be able to comprehend defects occurring in manufacturing stages such as welding, casting, and plastic forming.
To be able to determine the application areas of the ultrasonic testing method and evaluate its results.
To be able to determine the application areas of the radiographic testing method and evaluate its results.
To be able to determine the application areas of the magnetic particle testing method and evaluate its results.
To be able to determine the application areas of the eddy current testing method and evaluate its results.
To be able to determine the application areas of the liquid penetrant testing method and evaluate its results.
To be able to compare all non-destructive testing techniques with each other and decide which technique can be used where.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the course and its content. General information about non-destructive material testing.
Purposes of using non-destructive testing methods and classification of methods.
Material defects detectable by non-destructive testing.
Damages and structural defects occurring in materials during manufacturing stages such as casting and welding. Heat treatment defects.
Damages and structural defects occurring in materials during plastic forming stages such as forging and rolling.
Ultrasonic testing method and its basic principles.
Application areas of the ultrasonic testing method. Advantages of ultrasonic testing techniques.
Radiographic testing method and its basic principles.
Radiographic testing method and its basic principles.
Application areas of the radiographic testing method. Disadvantages and advantages of radiographic testing techniques.
An application example using the radiographic testing method: internal stress measurement.
Basic principles and application areas of the magnetic particle testing method.
Basic principles and application areas of the eddy current testing method.
Basic principles and application areas of the liquid penetrant testing method. Pressure gas or pressure liquid testing method.
assessment_rules: The midterm exam contributes 40% to the final grade, and the final exam contributes 60%. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decisions in the academic calendar.
bibliography: An Introduction to Nondestructive Testing, Matthew J.Golis, ASNT, 1991
